## Description

Describe the change and why it belongs in this repository.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Breaking change
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Agent, skill, or tooling update

## Checklist

- [ ] I assigned this pull request and applied at least one repository label
- [ ] I read the [Contributing Guidelines](../CONTRIBUTE.md)
- [ ] My change follows [CODING_CONVENTION.md](../CODING_CONVENTION.md)
- [ ] I ran `pnpm check`
- [ ] I ran `sh scripts/check-graphify-integrations.sh`
- [ ] I ran `nix flake check`
- [ ] I updated the relevant documentation and `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] I did not add emojis, comments that restate code, or files over 500 lines
- [ ] I did not weaken a lint rule, test, threshold, or workflow
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

## Verification

Paste the commands you ran and their results. A claim without output is not
evidence.
